AffixItemOptionDef.description: A weapon, a tool or a piece of armor with Apotheosis's affixes, its rarity rolled for the opener's world tier.

limit.description: How often one container may hold it: 1 for something unique, 0 (the default) for any number.
limit.title: Limit

tiers.description: The world tiers it is for; every tier without it.
tiers.title: Tiers

weight.description: How likely it is against the other options a roll can afford.
weight.title: Weight

BudgetDef.description:
The points a container may draw: half of all rolls lie between ``min`` and ``medium``, the other half between
``medium`` and ``max``, each half evenly, so a high roll is rare.

medium.description: The roll in the middle: half of all containers hold less.
medium.title: Medium

min.description: The least a container holds, at the first world tier.
min.title: Min

BudgetDef.title: BudgetDef

CoinsOptionDef.description:
Coins worth a number of mob kills of the opener's tier, 50 to 150 % of it as a mob's drop is. Its cost is not
written: ``kills`` times the table's ``kill_points``, which is what ties points to kills.

kills.description: How many kills' coins it gives, on average.
kills.title: Kills

limit.description: How often one container may hold it: 1 for something unique, 0 (the default) for any number.
limit.title: Limit

tiers.description: The world tiers it is for; every tier without it.
tiers.title: Tiers

weight.description: How likely it is against the other options a roll can afford.
weight.title: Weight

CoinsOptionDef.title: CoinsOptionDef

CountDef.description: How many of an item one pick gives: a whole number from ``min`` to ``max``, each as likely.
CountDef.title: CountDef

EnchantLevelsDef.description: The enchanting levels an item or a book is enchanted with, as at an enchanting table: from ``min`` to ``max``.
EnchantLevelsDef.title: EnchantLevelsDef

GemOptionDef.description: A gem of Apotheosis's, its kind and purity rolled for the opener's world tier.

limit.description: How often one container may hold it: 1 for something unique, 0 (the default) for any number.
limit.title: Limit

rolls.description: The gem is the purest of this many rolls: 1 by default, more for a better gem at the same tier.
rolls.title: Rolls

tiers.description: The world tiers it is for; every tier without it.

weight.description: How likely it is against the other options a roll can afford.

ItemOptionDef.description: Items: food, ingots, gems, ores, gear; enchanted with ``enchant``, which turns a book into an enchanted book.

count.description: How many one pick gives: 1 by default.

enchant.description: Enchants it with these levels, with the enchantments random loot may carry (books included).

TierDef.description:
What a world tier means for the table: the mob level its kills are counted at, and how much it raises the
budget.

budget_percent.description: The budget at this tier, in percent of the table's own: 100 at the first tier, more at a later one.
budget_percent.title: Budget Percent

level.description: The mob level a kill is counted at for this tier: the coins of a kill are the curve coin_drop there.
level.title: Level

description: What a kind of container holds, drawn by loot points for the player who opens it.

kill_points.description: The points one mob kill is worth: the coins of a kill cost this much.
kill_points.title: Kill Points

luck_percent.description: How much each point of the opener's luck (minecraft:luck) adds to the budget, in percent.
luck_percent.title: Luck Percent
